description: Use this when the buyer has chosen what to order and you have the details: it prices the order exactly as the checkout will charge it — the bouquet(s), add-ons, the shop's launch discount or the buyer's promo code, the delivery fee — and checks the time, without creating anything. Takes: the bouquet(s) (bouquet_id from search; several bouquets of ONE florist with quantities in items); delivery or pickup; for delivery the street address with house number in Prague; the recipient's name and phone when someone else receives the flowers; the date and a time (one of the bouquet's offered times, or 'asap'); the buyer's name, e-mail and phone (+420…); an optional card message and note for the florist; the buyer's promo code if they have one. Above 10 000 Kč the buyer's billing address is required. Also on offer: address_mode 'ask_recipient' when the florist should agree the address with the recipient by phone — a surprise (the recipient's name and phone are then required); time 'agree_with_recipient' when the florist should agree the time with the recipient by phone (the recipient's name and phone are then required); company details (IČO) for a purchase by a company. Returns the breakdown, the total, the terms link and an order_intent; it creates nothing. The total is valid for exactly these details.

address.description: Delivery to a known address: street and house number in Prague.

address_mode.description: ask_recipient = the courier/florist agrees the address with the recipient by phone (a surprise); no address needed, delivery priced at the whole-city rate.

billing_address.description: The buyer's billing address — required by Czech tax rules when the order is over 10 000 Kč (unless buying for a company).

bouquet_id.description: One bouquet (shortcut for items with a single line).

company.description: Buying for a company — the invoice is issued to it.

items.description: Several bouquets from the SAME florist, with quantities.

bouquet_id.description: A bouquet_id as search results and bouquet details show it.

marketing_opt_in.description: true = the buyer asked for news and offers.

promo_code.description: The buyer's promo code, if they have one — works for guests and signed-in buyers alike; the checkout checks it.

recipient.description: Who receives the flowers, when it is someone else than the buyer — the courier calls them.

time.description: HH:MM from the offered times, or 'asap', or 'agree_with_recipient' (the florist agrees the time with the recipient by phone; delivery only).

unit.description: Apartment, floor, company at the door.

name: pinflower_quote_order
title: Price the order
